stories.title: A brief history of syslog timestamps, (Sun, Nov 22nd)
stories.description: BLUF: Debian and Ubuntu dropped a config directive in the rsyslogd package in early 2023.

stories.title: VirusTotal’s New Ransomware Detection Catches Malware Missed by All 75 Antivirus Engines
stories.description: VirusTotal's new behavior checks detected Python ransomware missed by all 75 antivirus engines by verifying actual file encryption.

stories.title: OpenRouter Drops 3 Providers After Researchers Catch Months of Prompt Theft at AI Hosting Firms
stories.description: Attackers stole AI prompts from three inference providers, prompting OpenRouter to remove 125 endpoints from Zero Data Retention eligibility.

stories.title: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps
stories.description: Ghostscript flaw CVE-2026-125396 allows crafted files to escape its sandbox and execute server commands through common file-processing apps.

stories.title: OpenRouter Users’ Private AI Chats Possibly Exposed Via Compromised Third-Party Providers
stories.description: OpenRouter has removed three AI hosting providers and revoked Zero Data Retention eligibility for 125 endpoints after researchers found evidence that some providers had been compromised or had failed to follow their data policies.

stories.title: Hackers Could Execute Commands on WordPress, Email and Print Servers Through Upload2Shell Flaw
stories.description: A flaw in Ghostscript let researchers run commands on WordPress, Roundcube webmail, and Linux print servers through routine file processing.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Microsoft Entra Connect Health Flaw to Access Admin Emails and Organization Data
stories.description: Attackers exploited a flaw in Microsoft Entra Connect Health to read administrator and technical contact email addresses, along with configuration data from affected organizations.

stories.title: FBI Investigating Apparent Hack of Its Key National Criminal Justice Database, AP Source Says
stories.description: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of a national law enforcement database that it maintains.

stories.title: President Trump Taps Kirsten Davies as National Cyber Director
stories.description: White House says the battle-tested cyber leader will drive an America First cyber strategy.

stories.title: Amazon: China-Linked Hackers’ AI Agents Exploited Medical Software Zero-Day
stories.description: A threat actor used autonomous Cairn AI agents to discover and exploit a critical MONAI Label vulnerability.

stories.title: A Single Malicious Webpage Let Researchers Hijack Meta Muse and Access Private Chats
stories.description: Researchers demonstrated Meta Muse flaws enabling conversation theft and cloud machine takeover; NebuSec says the issues are fixed.

stories.title: GnuPG Warns Critical GPGME Flaw Could Expose App Data via Malicious OpenPGP Keys
stories.description: GnuPG fixes critical GPGME flaw CVE-2026-129975, which malicious OpenPGP keys could trigger to potentially expose application data.

stories.title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
stories.description: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a six year old Florida business that claimed to use "advanced cryptographic tools" to restore data locked by ransomware, has been charged with wire fraud after an FBI sting operation found…

stories.title: WhatsApp Fixes Flaw Uncovered While Disrupting Scam Campaign
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-23871, the vulnerability was found by WhatsApp’s security team, and it may have been used to make scam messages more credible.

stories.description: At least 178 top web destinations unwittingly served a variety of malware exploits against visitors over the past 24 hours thanks to a security vulnerability involving Optimizely, a company that helps websites customize user experiences and test out new…

stories.description: The cybercrime group Qilin has emerged as the world's most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months alone. But even top Russian hackers make operational security mistakes, and the administrator…
